name: update_project_protection_bypass
description:
Manage a project's deployment protection automation bypass secrets. requestBody can generate a secret (a random one if neither generate nor revoke is given), revoke a secret with optional regeneration, or update a bypass's note or environment-variable setting. Secrets grant access to protected deployments.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/projects/{idOrName}/protection-bypass --method PATCH. Fill placeholders from inputs.

idOrName.description: The unique project identifier or the project name

generate.description: Generate a new secret. If neither generate or revoke are provided, a new random secret will be generated.

note.description: Note to be displayed in the UI for this bypass

secret.description: Optional value of the secret to generate, don't send it for oauth2 tokens

revoke.description: Optional instructions for revoking and regenerating a automation bypass

regenerate.description: Whether or not a new automation bypass should be created after the provided secret is revoked

isEnvVar.description: Whether or not this bypass is set as the VERCEL_AUTOMATION_BYPASS_SECRET environment variable on deployments

note.description: Note to be displayed in the UI for this bypass

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
